No reported finding addresses no-show reporting being blocked after quick-complete.
R7 describes Start then immediate End producing LIVE completion and payout with no parent confirmation.
No finding about confirmCompletion transitioning before the missing-SCD 404.
No finding about coach late cancel with excused reason avoiding a no-show strike.
No finding about parent late cancel after start not recording a coach strike.
R3 covers a concurrent duplicate-insert race, not the coach's dispute blocking the family's or the missing cap on repeat disputes.

unmatched_reported.note: A concrete check-then-act race: an uncommitted dispute is invisible to the completion transaction's freeze check, so the payout is created unfrozen.
An unlocked check-then-insert lets a double-submit create two open disputes, which then breaks the Optional lookup.
An unlocked status check lets two concurrent resolutions both issue credits.
Using the already-cut gross as the session price under-refunds and over-cuts on later disputes.
The stored creditAmount is the requested argument rather than the amount actually credited, so it is wrong for NO_ACTION and FULL_CREDIT.
A naming issue with no concrete behavioural consequence shown.
Speculative, because it depends on an unread StuckCompletionSweeper query.
Both schedule status lists omit PAUSED, so paused sessions are hidden from the coach and the parent.
The missing upper time limit is a design concern; its harm comes from F1 rather than being a separate defect.
Speculative, because it depends on the controller passing the role from the request body.
The resolution semantics are undefined and no concrete defect is shown.
